# Fixed type-use DEX fixture

`TypeUses.java` is project-authored. `type-uses.dex` is generated by the adjacent `generate_fixture.py` with JDK 17 and D8 build-tools 37.0.0, `--min-api 27 --no-desugaring`. Its SHA-256 and seven independently recorded SDK `dexdump` events are in `expected.json`; actual compiler output may vary across toolchains. The fixture is not an Android/ART runtime result. The synthetic native decoder test additionally covers both filled-new-array encodings.

To regenerate, pass `--source TypeUses.java`, `--java` pointing to the JDK java binary, `--d8` pointing to `d8.jar`, `--expected-sha256` from `expected.json` and a new `--output` directory. The generator records tool/input hashes and never explicitly deletes files. CTest stores a fresh CLI/oracle receipt per invocation under the build directory; those retained files can accumulate.

`ArrayTypeUses.java` generates `array-type-uses.dex` with the same JDK/D8 settings. Two- and six-argument array literals cause D8 to emit `filled-new-array` and `filled-new-array/range`; the independent dexdump observations and digest are in `expected-array.json`. CLI/C/JNI tests cover both normal output and rejection of an out-of-range type index. This remains structural/static evidence, not an ART run.
